about.title: About StoryCreator
about.subtitle: Learn a new language by reading bilingual stories
about.purposeText: StoryCreator is a website I built to learn Portuguese by reading. I read a lot, and I couldn't find many books I actually liked available in easy Portuguese with an English translation next to it. So I made a place where I can generate exactly the kind of story I enjoy reading — and use that to improve my Portuguese. Every story is stored sentence by sentence in two languages, so you can read them side by side.
about.personalProjectText: This website is a personal project, not a professional service. I build and maintain it in my free time, so as I add features and make changes there may occasionally be brief outages or disruptions.
about.personalProjectNote: Thanks for your patience while I keep improving it!
about.readingText: Stories are stored as parallel sentences in your native language and the language you're learning, so you can read them side by side. Choose from 17 languages and three levels — beginner, intermediate and advanced — and the vocabulary adapts to you.
about.writerAccessTitle: Reading is free — writing uses paid AI
about.writerAccessText: Reading stories is free and open to everyone. Creating and generating stories (and the AI review and regeneration tools) is limited to accounts with creator access, because every generation calls a paid AI model that costs me real money out of pocket.
about.writerAccessNote: Want to write your own stories? Contact me to request creator access — just keep in mind that generating them isn't free to run.
about.otherWebsiteText: If you enjoy StoryCreator to learn languages, you can also check out my other website for a more classic lesson format:
about.openSourceText: This project is open source and is also a chance for me to explore coding with AI assistance. The full source code is available on GitHub.
about.githubStar: ⭐ Star the repository to show your support!
about.githubIssues: 🐛 Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue on GitHub — your feedback is valuable!
about.getStartedText: Browse the stories or, if you have creator access, write your own!
